summary.scope: Rain Bird HE-VAN, VAN, U-Series, MPR fixed/flat/strip/stream, SQ and 1300/1400; excludes R-VAN, rotors and bodies.
safeImplementation: Keep all 292 ordinary square/triangle rows unchanged.
Expose SQ-QTR, SQ-FUL and SQ-3QTR existing precipNoOverlapMmH as a separate applicationMmHr, basis single, with a no-overlap label.
Interpolate this extra field only between valid rows on the same selected nozzle/throw and pressure grid. Do not lose it in lerpRow.
Keep SQ-HLF application rate withheld and respect hydraulic nozzle gating.
Keep MPR strips and bubblers without invented headline rates; use Not applicable or No published data with the specific reason.
Runtime for 10 mm is 600/applicationMmHr or 600/selected published square/triangle rate, with the selected basis explicit. This is calculated runtime, not another manufacturer specification.
sourceCautions: Square/triangle chart spacing is 50% of throw diameter, under zero-wind test conditions, not single-head wetted-area precipitation.
SQ no-overlap test mounting height is 6 inches / approximately 0.15 m.

SQ-QTR published rate differs by about 3–6.5% from calculation using rounded US gph and square dimensions; retain its explicitly published rate rather than silently recomputing. No new source resolves why.
SQ-FUL and SQ-3QTR US published rates agree within about 1% with printed flow/footprint arithmetic.
SQ-HLF at 30–50 psi differs by roughly 14–28%; its previously identified conflict remains.
Metric values from one pressure grid must not be copied onto exact-converted US pressure rows.
